name: safetyculture-mcp
description: Ask your Mitti (formerly SafetyCulture) data anything: inspections, actions, issues, schedules, credentials, analytics and reports. Read-only by default.
long_description: Independent open-source MCP server. Not affiliated with SafetyCulture Pty Ltd or Mitti. Read-only unless you choose a write mode; destructive changes need a dry run and a one-time confirmation. Leave the token empty and turn on demo mode to try it with a fictional organisation.

sc_api_token.title: Mitti / SafetyCulture API token
sc_api_token.description: Starts with scapi_. Create it as a read-only integration user. Leave empty if you turn on demo mode.

sc_mode.title: Access mode
sc_mode.description: read-only (default), write (create and update), or full (adds delete, archive and bulk changes, each needing confirmation).

sc_pii.title: Personal data in results
sc_pii.description: contact (default: hide emails and phone numbers), strict (also hide names), or none.

sc_demo.title: Demo mode
sc_demo.description: Use the built-in fictional organisation instead of your account. No token needed.
